title: Deprecate ``DataFrame.first`` and ``Series.first``
body:
See https://github.com/dask/dask/issues/10347.

Fixes this deprecation:

```
FAILED dask/dataframe/tests/test_dataframe.py::test_first_and_last[first] - FutureWarning: first is deprecated and will be removed in a future version. Please create a mask and filter using `.loc` instead
FAILED dask/dataframe/tests/test_dataframe.py::test_first_and_last[last] - FutureWarning: first is deprecated and will be removed in a future version. Please create a mask and filter using `.loc` instead
```

- [x] Tests added / passed
- [x] Passes `pre-commit run --all-files`
